job.title: Mechanical Maintenance Plumber
job.description:
Mechanical Maintenance Engineer / plumber | FM Service Provider | Commercial Building Teddington, South West London | Up to £45,000 per annum

An exciting opportunity has arisen to join a leading FM service provider based in Teddington, South West London. We are currently recruiting for a Multi-Skilled Mechanical Maintenance Engineer / plumber for a static, site-based role within a large and prestigious commercial building.

The successful candidate will be a fully qualified Mechanical Maintenance Engineer, holding a City & Guilds / NVQ Level 2 qualification, with a proven track record in commercial building maintenance.

You will be responsible for carrying out mechanically-biased M&E and fabric planned and reactive maintenance as part of a close-knit team of three engineers, working alongside an on-site supervisor. You will be responsible for all landlord services across the building and will be required to demonstrate hands-on knowledge and experience of the following:

Duties

  • HVAC plant and plant room maintenance
  • Air conditioning — air handling units and fan coil units (filter changes and cleaning)
  • Chillers — monitoring and resets
  • Pumps, motors and cooling tower maintenance
  • Water treatment — temperature checks (non-dosing)
  • Lighting — small installations, fault-finding, lamping, ballast changes, control panels and power distribution
  • Emergency lighting testing and certification
  • Fire alarm testing
  • UPS systems — monitoring and taking readings
  • Pressurisation units
  • BMS — monitoring hot and cold systems
  • Plumbing — unblocking toilets, changing taps, seals, etc.
  • General building fabric maintenance
  • Escorting and overseeing sub-contractors
Hours of Work

  • Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00 (40-hour week)
  • One week in 7, working a 10:00–19:00 shift
  • On-call: 1 in 4 rota
Package

  • Basic salary up to £45,000 per annum
  • On-call allowance of an additional £5,000 per annum (1 in 4 rota)
  • 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
  • Birthday off as an additional holiday
  • Company pension scheme
  • Excellent benefits package
  • Internal and external training courses
  • Genuine career progression opportunities
  • Substantial overtime available
Requirements

  • Mechanically / plumbing qualified — C&G / NVQ Level 2 (minimum)
  • Copies of all trade certificates will be required upon application
  • Proven track record in commercial or property maintenance
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Reliable, honest and hardworking
To apply, please send your CV to Dan Barber at CBW Staffing Solutions for more information.

job.title: Mobile Multi-Skilled Engineer
job.description:
Mobile Multi-Skilled Engineer – Commercial Sites – Thames Valley, South West  & Midlands – Up to £45,000

CBW Staffing Solutions are currently recruiting for a Mobile Multi-Skilled Engineer, ideally with an electrical bias, to cover a portfolio of commercial properties across the Thames Valley, South West  & Midlands .

The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out planned preventative maintenance (PPM), reactive maintenance and general building services works across a varied portfolio of sites. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer who enjoys working independently, travelling between sites and dealing with a variety of maintenance requirements.

The ideal candidate will live somewhere Central in the patch (Oxford, Burford, Cirencester, Chelthenham) Areas covering include Bristol, Reading, Southampton, Watford, Cheltenham, Swindon, Milton Keynes and Worcester.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Carry out planned preventative and reactive maintenance across multiple sites.
  • Electrical maintenance, fault-finding and minor installation works.
  • Lighting, emergency lighting and power distribution.
  • Testing and maintenance of electrical systems and equipment.
  • Basic mechanical maintenance, including pumps, motors, AHUs and FCUs.
  • Carry out general plumbing and building fabric maintenance.
  • Monitor and investigate faults with building services equipment.
  • Complete routine plant and equipment checks.
  • Respond to reactive maintenance issues and breakdowns.
  • Liaise professionally with clients, site contacts and contractors.
  • Complete maintenance records, job sheets and compliance documentation.
  • Ensure all works are completed safely and in line with relevant Health & Safety procedures.
  • Travel between sites across the Thames Valley, South West & Midlands.
Hours & Package
  • Salary up to £45,000 per annum
  • Monday to Friday – 08:00–17:00
  • Call-out rota – details to be confirmed
  • 22 days annual leave + bank holidays
  • Company vehicle + fuel card
  • Overtime opportunities
  • Ongoing training and development
Requirements
  • Electrically or mechanically qualified – City & Guilds / NVQ Level 2 or above
  • 18th Edition desirable for electrically biased candidates
  • Proven experience within commercial building maintenance
  • Multi-skilled building services experience
  • Strong electrical or mechanical maintenance and fault-finding skills
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Good communication and customer service skills
  • Must be able to travel across the required area
Please send your CV to Dan Barber at CBW Staffing Solutions for more information and to avoid missing out on this opportunity!

job.title: Technical Services Manager
job.description:
Technical Services Manager – Leading FM Provider – City of London - up to 80k + Package

Would you like to work for one of the leading maintenance providers in London? 

Have you got a proven track record with the technical facilities and maintenance services industry?

If so please read on...

An excellent opportunity has arisen to join one of the UK's leading companies in the facilities industry.

They currently maintain a number of facilities and maintenance contracts across the UK and are looking for a Technical Services Manager to work in a high profile building based in the City of London. 

The main purpose of the job will be to ensure that technical operations within the building are maintained to a very high standard. 

The role will also be responsible for managing the maintenance shift team on site and also dealing with external subcontractors. The role will be supported by a site admin and also a team of four multi skilled shift engineers.

The technical manager will also need to maintain the site's PPM's to 100% completion at a high quality level, ensure compliance and health and safety are conducted to a high standard and also make sure the asset register is updated on a routine basis.

Other on site duties will also include:
  • Manage all technical issues across the buildings.
  • Responsible for managing the company’s H&S and environmental performance on each site.
  • Plan and implement building shutdowns and basic client project works.
  • Responsible for managing the company’s quality procedures on each site.
  • Recruitment of any new staff required on sites.
  • Responsible for the technical development of all staff, which will include annual appraisals.
  • Management of client relationships on a daily basis.
  • Management of all reports.
  • Manage any additional business opportunities that will deliver client satisfaction and increase contract sales revenue.
  • Responsible for the permit system.
Applicants for this role must be able to demonstrate the following:
  • Qualified in electrical or mechanical engineering discipline; C&G, HNC, HND or higher.
  • Strong understanding of building management systems.
  • Strong technical engineering understanding.
  • Previous HV experience.
  • Previous experience of managing engineering teams.
  • Experience of service delivery in high profile financial offices or critical data centres.
  • Ability to communicate both verbally and in writing with all levels of staff and clients.

job.title: Contract Manager
job.description:
Contract Manager – Leading FM Service Provider – Four blue chip buildings - City of London - 75K+ package

Would you like to work for an established, stable building maintenance contractor that actually values their staff?

Do you have experience of managing commercial maintenance contracts?

One of the established names in the commercial building maintenance industry is looking to recruit a Contract Manager to be based in the City of London and to work across a portfolio of four commercial contracts. 

They are looking for an individual from a strong technical background who will be able to provide a first class customer service and be able to organise, manage and motivate their maintenance teams.

The role will also be reporting directly to the Area General Manager and will be responsible for managing and growing a small portfolio of commercial properties. 

There are a number of existing clients with where there are long term relationships and there will also be an opportunity to identify new business opportunities.   

Time will be spent across each of the locations in Central London and the hours of work are Monday to Friday, 8-5. 

There will also be the option to work from home as and when needed. 

The main duties of the role are as follows:
  • Ensure client satisfaction levels are at a constantly high level, leading to development of the contract to increase the portfolio/contract responsibilities.

  • Ensure contractual levels are obtained and superseded and an in depth knowledge of the contract is maintained and demonstrated on the internal monthly contractual review meetings with the senior management team.

  • Ensure contractually agreed KPIs / SLAs are met.

  • Attend strategic contractual/operational meetings with the client on a weekly basis, or as required.

  • Ensure successful completion of all reactive and PPM works orders to ensure timely completion and close out, meeting KPIs and SLAs as necessary.

  • Provide leadership and management to the site team as necessary.

Applicants for this role must be able to meet the following criteria:
  • Recognised apprenticeship and fully electrically or mechanically qualified to recognised level ie C&G, HNC/HND.

  • Proven experience and involvement in managing multi-site businesses.

  • Financial understanding including P&L and budgets.

  • Must be capable of prioritising and solving problems often under pressure, utilising innovative solutions.

  • Must be a team player committed to working in a quality and professional environment.

  • Strong people management skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

job.title: Air Conditioning Engineer
job.description:
Mobile Air Conditioning Engineer -  Leeds - Global Facilities Management Organisation: Commercial 

CBW Staffing Solutions are seeking a skilled Air Conditioning Engineer to join our client’s team of facilities management professionals. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in HVAC maintenance and repair, responsible for maintaining and servicing air conditioning systems to ensure optimal performance and end-client satisfaction.

The ideal candidate will have experience of pressure leak tests, compressor changes and braising.

This is a mobile role, covering Leeds and the surrounding area.

Package
  • Competitive salary up to £45,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Van & fuel card supplied (private use permitted!)
  • Core hours are Monday - Friday (40 hours per week)
  • Participation in an ‘out of hours’ on call rota (to be confirmed)
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
Responsibilities
  • Maintain, service and troubleshoot a variety of air conditioning systems, including split systems, VRV/VRF systems, and chillers
  • Perform routine maintenance tasks, such as cleaning coils, replacing filters, moving parts, to prolong the lifespan of HVAC equipment
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical and electrical faults in air conditioning units, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum efficiency
  • Conduct inspections and assessments of HVAC systems to identify potential issues and recommend appropriate solutions
  • Collaborate with other maintenance personnel and contractors to coordinate complex repairs and system upgrades
  • Adhere to safety protocols and industry regulations to promote a safe working environment
Qualifications
  • Proven experience as an Air Conditioning Engineer or similar role within the facilities management industry
  • Hold your F-Gas Cat 1 Regulations certification
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, including installation, maintenance, and repair techniques
  • Familiarity with refrigeration principles and equipment
  • Proficiency in diagnosing and troubleshooting mechanical and electrical faults
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Effective communication and customer service skills

If you are a dedicated Air Conditioning Engineer, looking for a rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your full CV or contact Amy O'Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

This is a varied mobile role, responsible for ensuring buildings, facilities and essential services remain safe, compliant and fully operational. You will carry out both planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance, working across a range of building services systems.

  • Carrying out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) in accordance with schedules and client requirements.
  • Responding to reactive maintenance requests and diagnosing faults efficiently.
  • Undertaking electrical maintenance, fault finding and repairs across commercial buildings.
  • Carrying out general building services and mechanical maintenance.
  • Maintaining HVAC, heating, ventilation and associated building services.
  • Undertaking minor installation and repair works.
  • Carrying out lighting, emergency lighting and basic electrical works.
  • Inspecting plant, equipment and building services to identify potential issues.
  • Supporting compliance with relevant health & safety legislation and industry standards.
  • Completing maintenance records, job sheets and reports accurately using the required systems.
  • Liaising professionally with site contacts, colleagues, contractors and the client.
  • Responding to occasional out-of-hours or emergency requirements where required.
  • Maintaining a high standard of customer service while working within occupied commercial and testing environments.
Person Specification:

  • An electrical bias is preferred, alongside a good understanding of wider building services and mechanical systems.
  • Experience working within Facilities Management, Building Services or a commercial environment.
  • A strong electrical maintenance background.
  • Experience carrying out PPM and reactive maintenance.
  • Good fault-finding and diagnostic skills.
  • A practical understanding of mechanical and building services systems.
  • The ability to work independently and manage a varied workload.
  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • A professional approach when working within client premises.
  • A full UK driving licence.
  • City & Guilds / NVQ Level 2 or 3 in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations.
  • Inspection & Testing qualification.
  • Experience with HVAC, mechanical systems, plumbing or general building maintenance.

job.title: Electrician
job.description:
Electrician - Central Belt - Salary up to £50,000 DOE plus Bonuses

Due to continued growth in the renewable energy sector, we are recruiting experienced professionals to support the delivery of residential and commercial Solar PV and Battery Storage installations across Scotland and the wider UK.

Successful candidates will join dedicated installation teams, working together to deliver high-quality renewable energy systems safely, efficiently, and to industry standards.

Each installation team typically consists of:

  • Renewable Energy Electricians (2 positions per team) – Responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, and certification of Solar PV and Battery Storage systems, including AC/DC wiring, inverters, and associated electrical equipment in accordance with current industry regulations.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, commission and test Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) electrical systems.
  • Complete AC/DC wiring, inverters, consumer unit upgrades and associated electrical works.
  • Carry out inspection, testing, fault finding and certification in accordance with BS 7671 and relevant industry standards.
  • Accurately complete digital job records, certification and quality assurance documentation, including photographic evidence where required.
  • Liaise professionally with customers, site teams and project managers to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Maintain high standards of health, safety and workmanship, supporting labourers and apprentices where required.
Person Specification:

Essential:

  • NVQ Level 3 in Electrical Installation (or equivalent)
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • Inspection & Testing qualification (2391 or equivalent)
  • ECS/JIB Gold Card
  • Full UK Driving Licence
  • Minimum three years' electrical installation experience
  • Strong knowledge of BS 7671 and safe isolation procedures
  • Comfortable using tablets or digital job management systems
Desirable:

  • Experience installing Solar PV and Battery Storage - (training/certification on EV charging will be provided).
  • Experience working on social housing or large-scale renewable energy programmes.
  • Knowledge of G98/G99 grid connection requirements.
  • Manufacturer training on leading renewable energy products is advantageous but not essential.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £50,000 DOE plus bonus & OT (opportunity to reach up to £70,000)
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Uniform, PPE and specialist tools provided.
  • Accommodation and meal allowances when working away where required.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Mechanical Plumber
job.description:
Site based Mechanical Plumber - Birmingham - Global Facilities Management Organisation

CBW Staffing Solutions are currently hiring for a skilled and motivated Mechanical Plumber for our facilities management client’s on-site team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in mechanical systems maintenance and a proactive approach to problem-solving. As a Mechanical Plumber, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the optimal performance and longevity of the end-client’s mechanical infrastructure.

This is a permanent and full-time position, static based in Birmingham.

Package:
  • Competitive salary up to £42,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Core hours are Monday to Friday (40 hours per week)
  • Participation in 'out of hours' on call rota
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
Responsibilities:
  • Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and repairs on mechanical systems, including HVAC, pump systems, air compressors, water chillers, plumbing, boilers, and other related equipment.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues, implementing effective solutions to minimise downtime.
  • Conduct preventative maintenance tasks to ensure equipment reliability and longevity.
  • Maintain accurate records of all maintenance activities, including work orders, inspections, and repairs.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and industry standards.
  • Assist in the procurement of necessary parts and supplies for maintenance tasks.
  • Provide technical support and guidance to junior maintenance staff as needed.
  • Respond promptly to emergency maintenance requests and provide timely resolutions.
Requirements:
  • Qualified to at least Level 3 City & Guilds in Mechanical Maintenance Engineering or Plumbing & Heating or equivalent.
  • Proven experience in mechanical maintenance within the facilities management industry.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, including HVAC, plumbing, and boilers.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues.
  • Familiarity with preventative maintenance practices and procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, blueprints, and schematics.
If you are a dedicated Mechanical Plumber looking for a rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your full CV or contact Amy O'Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

job.title: Heating Engineer
job.description:

job.title: Tenant Liaison Officer
job.description:
Tenant Liaison Officer - Inverness - Salary up to £35,000 DOE

CBW are currently recruiting for an experienced Resident Liaison Officer to join a leading Renewables team based in Inverness.

The role is focused on ensuring residents are kept fully informed, supported and engaged before, during and after works take place. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with residents, respond to queries and concerns, coordinate information with project teams, and help minimise disruption associated with construction activities.

This is a Inverness based position with regular travel throughout the north of Scotland, reflecting the geographical spread of current and future projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the principal contact for residents throughout the lifecycle of works.
  • Provide clear, accurate and timely information regarding planned works, programme dates, access requirements, progress and completion.
  • Build positive and professional relationships with residents, maintaining trust and confidence throughout the project.
  • Identify resident concerns at an early stage and ensure appropriate action is taken.
  • Communicate changes to programmes, working arrangements or planned activities promptly.
  • Ensure residents understand what to expect before, during and following works to their property or communal areas.
  • Undertake regular visits to properties and residential areas affected by project activities.
  • Engage directly with residents to understand their experience and identify any issues requiring attention.
  • Record and follow up resident queries, requests and concerns through to resolution.
  • Identify individual circumstances or additional support requirements and ensure these are communicated to the appropriate members of the project team.
  • Arrange and participate in resident information meetings, briefings and engagement sessions.
  • Prepare and distribute relevant project information and updates.
  • Support residents in understanding project schedules, key milestones and expected completion dates.
  • Receive and manage resident complaints and concerns in a professional and constructive manner.
  • Work with the relevant project, site and management personnel to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Keep residents informed of progress where an issue cannot be resolved immediately.
  • Monitor outstanding matters and ensure appropriate follow-up takes place.
  • Escalate significant, recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate level of management.
  • Report hazards, incidents, environmental concerns or other matters requiring management attention.
Person Specification:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive relationships with a wide range of people.
  • A professional, approachable and empathetic manner.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to understand and respond appropriately to resident concerns.
  • Effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with challenging situations.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries, priorities and deadlines.
  • Good attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
  • Previous experience in a resident-facing, customer service, community engagement or similar role.
  • Experience within construction, housing, property, facilities management, refurbishment or a related environment would be advantageous.
  • Understanding of the challenges and sensitivities associated with working in occupied residential properties.
  • Experience of handling customer complaints, enquiries or service issues.
  • Familiarity with maintaining electronic records and using digital systems.

Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £35,000 DOE
  • Van and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Soft Services Manager
job.description:
Soft Services Manager – 9-Month FTC Salary: Up to £50,000
Contract: 9-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Location: Greenwich, London
Working Pattern: Hybrid

About the role

My client is currently recruiting for a Soft Services Manager to take a key leadership role within a busy and evolving service environment on a 9-month fixed-term contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on operational leader who enjoys improving services, developing teams, strengthening client relationships and finding smarter, more efficient ways of working.

You will have responsibility for overseeing operational delivery, supporting and developing management teams, strengthening contract performance and ensuring consistently high standards across a diverse portfolio of services.

The role will suit someone who is confident working at both strategic and operational level and who can turn ideas and recommendations into practical improvements that deliver measurable results.

 

Main Duties 

  • Lead and support operational managers, creating clear accountability and a positive culture of performance, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the effective delivery of Soft Services, ensuring contractual requirements, service standards and operational objectives are consistently achieved.

  • Build strong and professional relationships with clients, establishing effective communication, review and escalation processes.

  • Take ownership of contract performance, ensuring key information, obligations, variations, additional works and upcoming renewals are properly managed.

  • Review staffing structures, resource deployment, agency usage, overtime, supervision and cover arrangements to identify opportunities for greater efficiency.

  • Develop a clear understanding of productivity across different sites and use operational data to improve working practices and service delivery.

  • Strengthen budget and cost controls, working closely with Finance to understand variances, forecasting and operational expenditure.

  • Identify opportunities to improve value for money through procurement, equipment, consumables, stock management and working practices.

  • Introduce effective inspection, audit and performance management processes to ensure quality and compliance.

  • Work closely with relevant Health & Safety, Quality, HR, Finance and Procurement teams to ensure appropriate standards and controls are maintained.

  • Improve management information and introduce practical digital processes for scheduling, reporting, auditing, action tracking and documentation.

  • Strengthen workforce planning, recruitment, induction, training, attendance, succession planning and resource management.

  • Develop forward plans for key contracts, identifying renewal requirements, commercial risks, pricing considerations and opportunities for service improvement.

  • Contribute to the future development of the Soft Services function and provide evidence-based recommendations to senior leadership.

 

About you 

We are looking for someone with strong operational management experience within soft services, facilities management, cleaning, FM or a similar environment.

You will ideally have:

  • Proven experience managing operational teams and managers.

  • Strong contract and client management experience.

  • A good understanding of workforce planning and resource deployment.

  • Experience managing budgets, costs and commercial performance.

  • A track record of delivering operational improvements and efficiencies.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders across operational and support functions.

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into practical actions.

  • Experience of quality assurance, audits, compliance and performance management.

  • Confidence using digital systems and management information to improve operational control.

  • The ability to work independently while also building effective relationships across an organisation.

Most importantly, you'll be a practical, proactive and credible leader who can engage people, challenge existing ways of working and make improvements happen.

 

Why join?

This is an opportunity to make a real impact during a focused 9-month fixed-term assignment, helping to strengthen operational performance and shape the future direction of Soft Services.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Make a genuine impact on service performance and operational efficiency.

  • Lead and develop operational managers and teams.

  • Influence how Soft Services are delivered in the future.

  • Work closely with senior leaders and a range of professional functions.

  • Develop and implement new processes, systems and ways of working.

  • Build strong client relationships and influence service outcomes.

  • Work in a hybrid role based in Greenwich, London.

  • Earn a salary of up to £50,000, depending on experience.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Soft Services or Facilities Management professional looking for a 9-month fixed-term opportunity where you can make a tangible difference, we'd be keen to hear from you.

If you enjoy leading people, improving services and delivering measurable operational results, this could be an excellent next step for you.

 

If you would like to apply for this position please contact claire@cbwstaffingsolutions.com

job.title: Electricial Supervisor
job.description:
Electrical Compliance Supervisor - Glasgow - Salary up to £50,000 DOE

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Compliance Supervisor to join a growing renewable energy business delivering a high volume of domestic energy installations across Scotland.

This is a hands-on technical and supervisory position, responsible for maintaining consistently high standards of electrical quality, compliance and safety across a busy installation programme. You will work closely with a small team of Compliance Inspectors, installation teams and site management, carrying out both remote and on-site inspections across Solar PV, battery storage, Air Source Heat Pumps (ASHP) and Electrical Storage Heating installations.

The role offers a genuine mix of technical, field and office-based responsibilities, including reviewing electrical certification and photographic evidence, supporting installers with technical queries, identifying quality issues and providing coaching and training to installation and inspection teams.

There is also the opportunity for the successful candidate to become, or work towards becoming, a NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and support a team of Compliance Inspectors, ensuring inspection activity keeps pace with a high-volume installation programme.
  • Carry out remote and on-site inspections, reviewing workmanship, materials, installation methods and supporting documentation.
  • Apply strong practical electrical knowledge to assess the installation, wiring, configuration and commissioning of inverters and battery storage systems.
  • Identify and troubleshoot electrical and system faults both remotely and on-site.
  • Provide technical support to installation teams, inspectors and customers, acting as a key point of contact for electrical and system-related queries.
  • Support the training and development of site and office-based colleagues, enabling effective first-line fault diagnosis and technical triage.
  • Liaise with manufacturers and equipment suppliers to resolve technical issues, faults and warranty matters.
  • Monitor installation quality and identify examples of best and poor practice, feeding learning into toolbox talks, training and best-practice guidance.
  • Deliver technical updates, toolbox talks and product awareness sessions to installation and inspection teams.
  • Review photographic evidence and job documentation to ensure installations can be effectively inspected remotely.
  • Ensure electrical installation work meets relevant engineering specifications, BS 7671, NICEIC requirements, MCS standards and applicable health, safety and environmental requirements.
  • Review electrical certificates, including EICs, Minor Works Certificates and EICRs, for accuracy and compliance.
  • Ensure project documentation is complete and meets relevant renewable energy certification requirements before sign-off.
  • Support internal and external quality, compliance and regulatory audits.
Person Specification: You will be an experienced electrical professional with a strong understanding of renewable energy installations and a genuine interest in maintaining high standards of workmanship and compliance.

  • A strong electrical installation background with relevant industry experience.
  • Practical knowledge of Solar PV, battery storage and associated inverter systems.
  • Experience of electrical inspection, testing and fault finding.
  • Good working knowledge of BS 7671.
  • Understanding of MCS requirements and renewable energy compliance.
  • Experience reviewing electrical certification and installation documentation.
  • The ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues both remotely and on-site.
  • NICEIC Qualifying Supervisor experience or an individual working towards this level would be highly desirable.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £50,000 DOE
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Electrical Technical Manager

  • Monitor external contractors and supply chain partners, ensuring performance, compliance, quality and safety requirements are maintained.

  • Participate in an out-of-hours/on-call management rota as required.
  • Prepare regular contract performance, energy management and operational reports.
  • Monitor budgets, expenditure and financial forecasts to ensure effective commercial management.
  • Support and promote organisational values relating to ethics, equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties required by the Line Manager.
Benefits and Package The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
  • Life assurance equivalent to twice your annual salary.
  • Employee discounts with a wide range of major retailers and brands.
  • Gym membership discounts.
  • Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Holiday purchase scheme.
  •  £55,000 plus uplift for AP And HP and on-ca;;
Essential Requirements
  • HNC/HND in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
  • Recognised electrical qualifications and/or fully qualified electrician status.
  • At least five years' post-qualification experience within a comparable technical or contract management position.
  • Demonstrable experience managing electrical and hard services within a contractual environment.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Good commercial and financial management experience.
  • Full UK driving licence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Disclosure Scotland/PVG clearance.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and CAFM systems.
Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience working within healthcare facilities management.
  • Knowledge of relevant healthcare technical standards, including SHTM 06-01, SHTM 06-02 and SHTM 06-03.
  • LV and HV Authorised/Approved Person experience or certification.

Monday to Friday - 08:00am to 17:00pm

  • Preventative Maintenance (PPM): Conduct routine preventative maintenance on diverse chiller systems, including air-cooled, water-cooled, absorption, and adiabatic chillers, to ensure optimal performance and longevity.

  • Carry out F-Gas leak detection, recovery, and recharging in strict compliance with current F-Gas regulations and environmental standards.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for system optimization and efficiency improvements, advising clients on best practices and potential upgrades.
  • Liaise professionally and directly with clients, providing clear explanations of work carried out, identifying any further required works, and building strong working relationships.

  • Participate in an out-of-hours on-call rota for emergency breakdowns as required which is currently every 14 weeks.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to junior technicians or apprentices when appropriate.
 
In return, my client is offering a very competitive package including:
  • 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays
  • Van & Fuel Card provided
  • Travel time: 1 hour each way
  • Tablet & Work phone provided
  • Full company uniform
  • Lots of overtime available

  • NVQ Level 2/3 in Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, City & Guilds 2079, or equivalent
  • Current F-Gas Category 1 certification (Essential).
  • Strong track record of working on various commercial and industrial chiller manufacturers.
  • Full, clean UK Driving Licence (Essential)
  • Strong understanding of refrigeration cycles, thermodynamics, electrical control systems, and HVAC principles.
  • Proven ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings to diagnose faults.
